heading: Server Rack
bottomHtml:
Server Rack for Bangladesh – Secure & Organized IT Equipment Storage

A server rack is a sturdy metal cabinet or open frame designed to safely house servers, networking gear, and telecom devices. Commonly available in 19-inch sizes ranging from 6U to 42U, server racks suit everything from small offices to large data centers. In Bangladesh, trusted brands like Totem, APC, Tripp Lite, and Eaton are popular choices for their durability and quality. Ideal for Bangladeshi ISPs, data centers, and enterprises looking for reliable equipment management and improved cooling.
